ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #20
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Only carbon dioxide

   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

11. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 37 °C

12. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Milk souring

13. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
